explication: Shrimp Task Manager is an MCP server that helps AI clients plan, decompose, execute, and track development tasks, with persistent task memory and optional web interfaces. The principal workflow begins with an AI client invoking registered tools; task tools use prompts and, for supported operations, the task model. Planning and decomposition can incorporate specialized agents. The repository also includes an optional lightweight web GUI and a separate React Task Viewer. Some tool implementations and viewer-server wiring were not sampled, so those relationships are shown only where documented or evidenced.
